bibl.title: A lesson of self-control to Alexander in an Ashmolean ostracon.
bibl.seg: Rosalia Hatzilambrou, A lesson of self-control to Alexander in an Ashmolean ostracon.
bibl.note: Edition of a - in all probability - school text preserved on an Ashmolean ostracon, supposedly a letter sent by Darius to his satraps, in which Alexander is sketched as a naughty child who will be taught a lesson of 'self-control'. Upper Egypt? (acquired in Karnak), first century?
